almanac.todayDescription: Today's Vietnamese lunar date, day stem-branch, auspicious (hoàng đạo) or inauspicious (hắc đạo) day, good hours and what to do or avoid — computed from the Vietnam calendar standard.
almanac.todayIntro: The lunar date below follows the Vietnamese standard (UTC+7, Hồ Ngọc Đức rules). Switch to the app for a version personalised to your birth year.
almanac.monthDescription: Solar and lunar dates for every day of {month}, with auspicious (hoàng đạo) days marked — Vietnam calendar standard.
almanac.monthIntro: Each cell shows the solar day with its lunar day underneath. The first day of a lunar month shows the lunar month number.
almanac.pickDescription: The most favourable dates in the next 60 days for {task}, ranked by the almanac engine (宜/忌 matches, hoàng đạo days, day officer and lunar mansion). Vietnam calendar standard.
almanac.pickIntro: Ranking uses the day almanac only. The app also checks clashes with your birth year and favourable elements.
almanac.noDays: No suitable days found in this window.

zodiac.title: {animal} ({branch}) — Chinese zodiac
zodiac.description: Personality, element, compatible and clashing signs and birth years of the {animal} ({branch}) in the Vietnamese and Chinese zodiac.
zodiac.intro: The 12 earthly branches name years, months, days and hours. Your sign is the branch of your lunar birth year.
zodiac.yearNote: Years follow the lunar new year; people born in January or early February should check the exact lunar date.

tarot.cardOfDayDescription: Today's tarot card ({card}, {orientation}) drawn deterministically for {date}, with keywords and the classic Waite reading.
tarot.cardOfDayIntro: The same card is drawn for everyone on the same day (UTC) — exactly the card the Findme Daily Oracle shows. Open the app for a spread tied to your question.
tarot.cardDescription: {name} — upright and reversed meaning, keywords, element and astrological correspondence from the classic 1909 deck.

lifePath.title: Life path number {n} — {name}
lifePath.description: Meaning of life path number {n} ({name}): strengths, challenges, careers and how it is calculated from your birth date.
lifePath.intro: Your life path number is the sum of your birth date reduced to a single digit, keeping master numbers 11, 22 and 33.
lifePath.resultMaster: Master number — it also carries the energy of {base}
lifePath.howBody: Add the digits of the month, day and year separately, reduce each to a single digit (or 11/22/33), then add the three results and reduce again.

moon.title: Moon today — {phase} in {sign}
moon.description: Today's moon phase, illumination, zodiac sign of the Moon and Sun, and planets currently retrograde — computed from astronomical ephemerides.
moon.intro: Positions are sampled at 12:00 UTC. The Moon changes sign roughly every two and a half days.
